scope: Bounded 5000-step frozen-encoder CTC head fit, extending the failed 1000-step optimization budget with unchanged fit/quality gates.
hypothesis: The initial CTC readout is still leaving the all-blank solution between steps 750 and 1000. Test one longer head-only optimization budget before considering joint training; do not relax sequence-fit criteria.
pair_sampling: Eight pairs per training batch replace eight positive and eight TTS-negative slots, fixed seed431 pair permutations, same fixed complete windows in both arms. No original source labels are replaced by teacher classes.
advance: Require matched source schedules, first 16 training batches, representative inputs and validation exposure. Treatment must have zero continuous development events and <=1% worst engine/corpus and engine false fraction, with >=3 recall points over binary control. Use control best recall within the same strict gate, otherwise within a 2% false fraction, otherwise the zero-event control point with minimum worst-group false fraction (ties: highest recall, then lowest threshold). No final scoring or board change without promotion.
limits: Teacher weak labels from complete normal-speed training crops are neither human transcripts nor measured phonetic endpoints. Only training data prepare the labels and fit prescreen; existing development validation follows only after passing. No real-speaker or acoustic parity, P4 resources or full-call stability established by this study.
objective: Both arms keep the same 118 training pairs, original binary wake labels, weighted BCE and draw schedule. Full-resolution teacher greedy CTC paths yield 236 nonempty weak sequences (1364 phone labels), packed without relabelling source audio. Train-only phone logits use mean CTC NLL divided by target length over the 67 encoder outputs. Both arms share a 5000-step frozen-encoder head warmup; only treatment adds .01 times this loss during the fixed 1000 joint updates. Discard the complete auxiliary head before scalar INT8 export.

head_fit_gate.action: Run only the frozen-encoder head fit first. Do not launch joint training or score validation unless all fit criteria pass and original binary weights/optimizer remain unchanged. Do not adjust these criteria using results.

observation_change: Record head weights/draw digests and print fit every 250 updates; no loss, optimizer, RNG or binary-model changes.
